title: IRON REBELLION
description:
Built exclusively for virtual reality, Iron Rebellion delivers a hands-on piloting experience unlike traditional mech games. Climb inside the cockpit of a towering war machine, reach for switches, manage power systems, operate weapons, and physically control every aspect of your mech as you battle for supremacy on the battlefield.

Tactical Multiplayer WarfareForm elite 8v8 squads to dominate the fight in multiple game modes. Victory depends on teamwork and smart decision-making. 

No squad? No problem. Play against bots as you master your skills throughout different game modes.

 

Six Unique Mech ClassesChoose from six specialized mech classes, each designed for different combat roles and playstyles. Customize your loadout, install augments, refine your strategy, and create a machine tailored to your approach.

Cross-Platform VR Combat Fight alongside pilots on both PCVR and standalone Quest through a seamless cross-platform multiplayer integration. 

 

 

Have More Questions?Hop into our Discord and join an active community of other mech pilots.
description_short: Climb inside a colossal mech and take command from a fully interactive VR cockpit. Control every switch, weapon, and system, customize your mech, and face other pilots in tactical cross-platform multiplayer combat.
